sn11.13:1.3: Mahāli also features in [an10.47]() on the causes of good and bad deeds; in [sn22.60]() on Pūraṇa Kassapa’s theory that there is no purification of beings; and in [dn6](), where he is called Oṭṭhaddha (“hare-lip”) and shows himself to be familiar with the failed ascetic Sunakkhatta.
sn11.13:4.2: In [dn6]() he also asks about seeing celestial visions, and the Buddha gives a detailed explanation in terms of meditation attainments.
